product_one_liner.value: Naïve deploys AI employees to build products and run sales, marketing, and customer support for new and existing companies.
product_one_liner.notes: Naïve describes an autonomous-company runtime whose AI employees build applications, close deals, run campaigns, and serve customers for both new and existing businesses. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/OTnFKjw-founding-member-of-technical-staff-rl

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes organization-wide plans, metered usage, Pro, and custom commercial terms. Source: https://usenaive.ai/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Naïve's job posting explicitly says it is deployed at companies including Airwallex and Hackerrank. These are deployment claims, not investor or partner listings, although the source is a recruiting page rather than a customer case study. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/OTnFKjw-founding-member-of-technical-staff-rl | named_customers.0: Airwallex is explicitly named among companies where Naïve is deployed. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/OTnFKjw-founding-member-of-technical-staff-rl | named_customers.1: Hackerrank is explicitly named among companies where Naïve is deployed. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/OTnFKjw-founding-member-of-technical-staff-rl

employee_band.notes: The company-level profile reports a team size of 12, which maps to 11-20. Some individual job-page boilerplate reports a different count, so confidence is reduced. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Dealroom explicitly labels San Francisco as headquarters, and the company profile also lists San Francisco. A funding release describes the company as Palo Alto-based, so the city designation has some source inconsistency. Sources: https://dealroom.co/companies/na-ve and https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, United States. This is a secondary-source headquarters designation. Source: https://dealroom.co/companies/na-ve

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly states Founded: 2025. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive

eng_blog.notes: The index lists only one Engineering post. Other implementation-related launch posts examined did not identify engineer authors, so two qualifying engineer-authored posts were not established under the requested test. Sources: https://usenaive.ai/blogs and https://usenaive.ai/blogs/on-paperclip-and-open-source

public_docs.notes: Naïve's public documentation portal links to multiple substantive articles, including Agent, Session, and Events documentation. Source: https://usenaive.ai/docs

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live index lists six roles, but none contains the AI/ML/data-science title terms specified in the question. It does list a reinforcement-learning role titled Founding Member of Technical Staff — RL; the false answer follows the question's explicit title-keyword test rather than treating RL as an additional qualifying keyword. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs

model_provider.value: OpenRouter, routing to models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, and Mistral.
model_provider.notes: The LLM documentation calls Naïve a wrapper over OpenRouter and explicitly names Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, and Mistral among its model providers. Source: https://usenaive.ai/docs/getting-started/llm

compliance_certs.notes: The complete security page names none of the five requested certifications. It describes third-party infrastructure standards and provider attestations rather than claiming Naïve itself holds a certification. Source: https://usenaive.ai/security

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The financing announcement and latest-round record both identify Series A. Sources: https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/news-and-events/news/2026/08/announcement-technology-goodwin-advises-naive-28-5-million-series-a and https://tracxn.com | funding_date: The latest-round record gives August 6, 2026; Goodwin's related announcement is also dated August 2026. Both support the requested month, 2026-08. Sources: https://tracxn.com and https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/news-and-events/news/2026/08/announcement-technology-goodwin-advises-naive-28-5-million-series-a | funding_amount_usd: The financing announcement identifies a $28.5 million Series A, and the funding profile records it as the latest round. Sources: https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/news-and-events/news/2026/08/announcement-technology-goodwin-advises-naive-28-5-million-series-a and https://tracxn.com

raised_18mo.notes: The dated August 2026 announcement documents a $28.5 million Series A within the requested 18-month window. Source: https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/news-and-events/news/2026/08/announcement-technology-goodwin-advises-naive-28-5-million-series-a

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Founding Account Executive posting remains accessible with an Apply to role button. It is omitted from the main jobs index, so current hiring status has some uncertainty. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/atYRN3h-founding-account-executive

launched_6mo.notes: The October 6, 2026 Social Data launch introduced access to public data across 21 social networks, a substantive new capability within the requested six-month window. Source: https://usenaive.ai/blogs

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. No complete human leadership roster or qualifying dated C-level/VP appointment or departure could be verified. The site's team page is an agent-company marketplace; the available founder information is insufficient to rule out other leadership changes.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The sales solution page explicitly describes pushing leads, replies, and meeting bookings to HubSpot. This is a product-integration signal, not proof that Naïve's staff use HubSpot internally. Source: https://usenaive.ai/solutions/sales | crm_stack_signal.0: HubSpot is explicitly identified as a destination for leads, replies, and meeting bookings, establishing a product-integration signal. Source: https://usenaive.ai/solutions/sales
